summary: Evogene Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its first-quarter 2026 financial results press release and a slide presentation for its May 20, 2026 conference call. The filing is a routine earnings report by a foreign private issuer, containing no M&A, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The disclosure discusses the company's strategic transformation, technology platform advances, and new collaborations, but does not trigger any special-situations category under event-driven analysis.
